scheme_name: Thakur Sen Negi Utkrisht Chatravriti Yojana
other_conditions: Must be among the top 100 girls or top 100 boys in the Matric Examination conducted by the Himachal Pradesh Board of School Education.
Must be studying in a recognized (including professional/technical) institution within or outside the state.
Renewal for 10+2 class is contingent on satisfactory performance in internal examinations of the 10+1 class.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹11,000 per annum for two years awarded to 100 girls and 100 boys.
